newsitem.title: PERU: RESEARCH ALERT-Barings reiterates Telfonica as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Barings reiterates Telfonica as buy.

text.p: ING Barings said Tuesday it had reiterated its buy recommendation on Peru's flagship telecom Telefonica del Peru due to increased confidence in the firm's accounting.
-- Barings, in a statement, said that by adopting conservative accounting procedures Telefonica had eliminated "much of the concern and criticism we had over the last 18 months."
-- This conservative accounting had increased confidence in the firm despite lowering earnings estimates, Barings added.

-- The research company said it had lowered its estimate of Telefonica's earnings for 1997 by 13 percent to $1.71 per American Depositary Receipt from $1.97. It also lowered its estimate for 1998 by nine percent to $2.24 from $2.47.
-- Telefonica, which is controlled by Telefonica de Espana, is the Lima Stock Exchange's benchmark stock.
